summary: Random-key decoding maps one finite numerical key per vertex to a deterministic permutation.
description: Input is a vector of finite keys. Sort vertex indices by key and use the index for ties. Return every index exactly once in O(n log n) time.

It replaces permutation repair with an ordering representation suitable for numerical crossover. Routing, improvement, objective evaluation and reversibility of the representation are outside the component.
